content:
The fastest animal is the **peregrine falcon**, which can reach speeds over 240 mph (386 km/h) when diving (called a stoop) to catch prey.

If you're asking about land animals, the **cheetah** is the fastest, reaching speeds up to 70 mph (112 km/h) in short bursts.
